items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: I played with a very wonderful artist, his name was Bennett Matthews.

ctx.x: It might have been Lotte Lenya (PHONETIC). Did you meet her during those years?

At that time, see, those girls were busy up there and I was in the band, I was busy, too. (Inaudible). And names, you know, you remember names. And so then I made this contract and I went back. And as I said, I joined --- and (sic) then I was with (inaudible) Gene Kennedy. And we started -- I was playing at the Million Dollar Ballroom, (Inaudible) Million Dollar ballroom alright. You played tangos. waltzes. on 3rd and Broadway. It was able. And the man that ran the place was named Mr. (Hugh) Carrigan. He always…
Now, how long were you in Europe?
